description: Allows an owner to identify, pay the required fee for, and reclaim an impounded pet or animal under the Animal Welfare Act of 1998 and Meycauayan City Ordinance No. 2012-05.
whoMayAvail: Owners of impounded pets or animals
steps: Present a valid ID at the City Veterinary Office and obtain an Order of Payment.
Proceed to the impounding facility to identify the pet or animal.
Pay the required fee at the City Treasurer's Office and secure the Official Receipt.
Present the Official Receipt at the City Veterinary Office and obtain the Release Order.
Present the Official Receipt and Release Order at the impounding facility and reclaim the pet or animal.

detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: Any government institution that issues identification cards

clientSteps.action: Present a valid ID at the City Veterinary Office. Staff will check the impounding report, validate the ID, and issue an Order of Payment.
Proceed to the impounding facility and physically identify the pet or animal.
Pay the required fee at the City Treasurer's Office and secure the Official Receipt.
Present the Official Receipt at the City Veterinary Office so the release information can be recorded and the Release Order prepared.
Present the Official Receipt and Release Order at the impounding facility and reclaim the pet or animal.
